raw_context: Adults with eczema and persistent itching.
rationale_ko: NCIt C3001의 일반 습진 정의와 MeSH의 Eczema 개념을 대조했습니다. 원문에 없는 아토피 조건을 추가하지 않고 일반 습진으로 연결합니다. 같은 검색의 CTCAE 평가 개념은 기본 질환 개념으로 선택하지 않습니다.

definitions.text: A common chronic pruritic inflammatory skin disease with a strong genetic component. Onset typically occurs during the first 2 years of life.
A form of dermatitis characterized by red, itchy, scaly, or crusty patches that can be chronic or intermittent.
A form of dermatitis characterized by red, itchy, scaly, or crusty patches that can be chronic or intermittent.
A form of dermatitis characterized by red, itchy, scaly, or crusty patches that can be chronic or intermittent.

A group of conditions in which the skin becomes inflamed, forms blisters, and becomes crusty, thick, and scaly. Eczema causes burning and itching, and may occur over a long period of time. Atopic dermatitis is the most common type of eczema.
A disorder characterized by skin which becomes itchy, red, inflamed, crusty, thick, scaly, and/or forms blisters.
A disorder characterized by skin which becomes itchy, red, inflamed, crusty, thick, scaly, and/or forms blisters.

raw_context: Adults with ECZEMA and persistent itching.
rationale_ko: K001과 대소문자만 다르고 같은 일반 습진 개념을 가리킵니다. NCIt C3001과 MeSH의 정의 범위를 근거로 묶고 아토피 피부염으로 축소하지 않습니다.

raw_context: Patients with eczematous skin diseases; subtype not specified.
rationale_ko: MeSH의 Skin Diseases, Eczematous Concept에 입력 용어가 속합니다. 여러 발진성 피부 질환을 포괄하는 질환군 정의이므로 dermatitis 전체 또는 K001의 개별 습진 표현과 별도 그룹으로 유지합니다.

definitions.text: An inflammatory process affecting the skin. Signs include red rash, itching, and blister formation. Representative examples are contact dermatitis, atopic dermatitis, and seborrheic dermatitis.
Any of a variety of eruptive skin disorders characterized by erythema, oozing, vesiculation, and scaling. Etiology is varied.

raw_context: Adults with type-2 diabetes mellitus.
rationale_ko: 원문은 type-2 diabetes mellitus인 성인을 명시합니다. 제2형 당뇨병 개념으로 연결하고 K005 등의 대소문자·하이픈 변형과 같은 기본 개념으로 묶습니다. 원문에 없는 치료 조건은 추가하지 않습니다.

definitions.text: A type of diabetes mellitus that is characterized by insulin resistance or desensitization and increased blood glucose levels. This is a chronic disease that can develop gradually over the life of a patient and can be linked to both environmental factors and heredity.

A type of diabetes mellitus that is characterized by insulin resistance or desensitization and increased blood glucose levels. This is a chronic disease that can develop gradually over the life of a patient and can be linked to both environmental factors and heredity.
Diabetes mellitus caused by decreased insulin action in target tissues and insufficient production of insulin by pancreatic beta cells.

raw_context: Adults with Type 2 diabetes mellitus.
rationale_ko: 제2형 당뇨병의 긴 이름에 대응합니다. 제1형·임신성 당뇨병·당뇨 전단계와 구분하고 대소문자 변형은 같은 기본 개념으로 묶습니다.

definitions.text: A type of diabetes mellitus that is characterized by insulin resistance or desensitization and increased blood glucose levels. This is a chronic disease that can develop gradually over the life of a patient and can be linked to both environmental factors and heredity.

raw_context: Adults with autoimmune type 1 diabetes requiring insulin.
rationale_ko: 인슐린 분비 결핍을 특징으로 하는 제1형 당뇨병 개념입니다. 제2형의 인슐린 치료 여부와 구별합니다.

definitions.text: A chronic condition characterized by minimal or absent production of insulin by the pancreas.
A chronic condition characterized by minimal or absent production of insulin by the pancreas.
Diabetes mellitus caused by cell-mediated autoimmune destruction of pancreatic beta cells.

raw_context: CD with ileocolonic inflammation and fistula.
rationale_ko: 긴 이름을 추가 조회한 NCIt 크론병 정의와 회결장 염증·누공 원문을 비교합니다. CD의 문맥 기반 잠정 해석을 유지하며 같은 표기의 K008/K009로 전파하지 않습니다.

definitions.text: A gastrointestinal disorder characterized by chronic inflammation involving all layers of the intestinal wall, noncaseating granulomas affecting the intestinal wall and regional lymph nodes, and transmural fibrosis. Crohn disease most commonly involves the terminal ileum; the colon is the second most common site of involvement.
A chronic, transmural inflammation that can affect any location along the gastrointestinal tract.

A condition in which the gastrointestinal tract is inflamed over a long period of time. Crohn disease usually affects the small intestine and colon. Symptoms include fever, diarrhea, stomach cramps, vomiting, and weight loss. Crohn disease increases the risk of colorectal cancer and small intestine cancer. It is a type of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD).

A condition in which the gastrointestinal tract is inflamed over a long period of time. Regional enteritis usually affects the small intestine and colon. Symptoms include fever, diarrhea, stomach cramps, vomiting, and weight loss. Regional enteritis increases the risk of colorectal cancer and small intestine cancer. It is a type of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD).

A gastrointestinal disorder characterized by chronic inflammation involving all layers of the intestinal wall, noncaseating granulomas affecting the intestinal wall and regional lymph nodes, and transmural fibrosis. Crohn disease most commonly involves the terminal ileum; the colon is the second most common site of involvement.

raw_context: CD with gluten-triggered enteropathy.
rationale_ko: 추가 조회한 셀리악병의 글루텐 관련 장질환 정의와 원문을 비교합니다. CD를 이 문맥에서만 셀리악병으로 해석하고 전역 약어로 고정하지 않습니다.

definitions.text: An autoimmune genetic disorder with an unknown pattern of inheritance that primarily affects the digestive tract. It is caused by intolerance to dietary gluten. Consumption of gluten protein triggers an immune response which damages small intestinal villi and prevents adequate absorption of nutrients. Clinical signs include abdominal cramping, diarrhea or constipation and weight loss. If untreated, the clinical course may progress to malnutrition, anemia, osteoporosis and an increased risk of intestinal malignancies. However, the prognosis is favorable with successful avoidance of gluten in the diet.

A digestive disease that is caused by an immune response to a protein called gluten, which is found in wheat, rye, barley, and oats. Celiac disease damages the lining of the small intestine and interferes with the absorption of nutrients from food. A person with celiac disease may become malnourished no matter how much food is consumed.

An autoimmune genetic disorder with an unknown pattern of inheritance that primarily affects the digestive tract. It is caused by intolerance to dietary gluten. Consumption of gluten protein triggers an immune response which damages small intestinal villi and prevents adequate absorption of nutrients. Clinical signs include abdominal cramping, diarrhea or constipation and weight loss. If untreated, the clinical course may progress to malnutrition, anemia, osteoporosis and an increased risk of intestinal malignancies. However, the prognosis is favorable with successful avoidance of gluten in the diet.

raw_context: Patients with CD; no other disease description.
rationale_ko: CD를 확장할 문맥이 없습니다. 추가 조회한 크론병 후보나 기존 검색의 국가·원소·측정단위 후보는 선택 근거가 되지 않으므로 명시적 보류를 유지합니다.

raw_context: Metastatic non-small cell lung cancer after prior therapy.
rationale_ko: 원문의 긴 NSCLC 명칭이 후보와 맞습니다. 전이와 이전 치료 조건은 관찰 구간으로 보존하며 K131과 환자 적격성까지 같다고 보지 않습니다.

definitions.text: A group of at least three distinct histological types of lung cancer, including non-small cell squamous cell carcinoma, adenocarcinoma, and large cell carcinoma. Non-small cell lung carcinomas have a poor response to conventional chemotherapy.

A group of at least three distinct histological types of lung cancer, including non-small cell squamous cell carcinoma, adenocarcinoma, and large cell carcinoma. Non-small cell lung carcinomas have a poor response to conventional chemotherapy.

A group of lung cancers that are named for the kinds of cells found in the cancer and how the cells look under a microscope. The three main types of non-small cell lung cancer are squamous cell carcinoma, large cell carcinoma, and adenocarcinoma. Non-small cell lung cancer is the most common kind of lung cancer.

raw_context: Relapsed acute myeloid leukemia in adults.
rationale_ko: 원문이 AML의 뜻을 acute myeloid leukemia로 명시합니다. 재발 상태를 별도 보존하며 K012의 신장 혈관근지방종과 구별합니다.

definitions.text: Acute myeloid leukemia (AML) is a group of neoplasms arising from precursor cells committed to the myeloid cell-line differentiation. All of them are characterized by clonal expansion of myeloid blasts. AML manifests by fever, pallor, anemia, hemorrhages and recurrent infections.

A clonal expansion of myeloid blasts in the bone marrow, blood or other tissues. The classification of acute myeloid leukemias (AMLs) encompasses four major categories: 1) AML with recurrent genetic abnormalities; 2) AML with multilineage dysplasia; 3) Therapy-related AML; 4) AML not otherwise specified. The required bone marrow or peripheral blood blast percentage for the diagnosis of AML is 20% (WHO classification).
A rapidly progressive cancer of the blood and bone marrow consisting of the proliferation of abnormal myeloblasts, which are immature, dysfunctional white blood cells.
An aggressive (fast-growing) disease in which too many myeloblasts (immature white blood cells that are not lymphoblasts) are found in the bone marrow and blood.

raw_context: Renal angiomyolipoma in patients with tuberous sclerosis.
rationale_ko: 원문이 renal angiomyolipoma를 명시하여 긴 이름을 추가 조회했습니다. AML 검색의 백혈병 첫 결과를 거절하고 TSC 동반 조건을 유지합니다.

definitions.text: An angiomyolipoma arising from the kidney.
An angiomyolipoma arising from the kidney.

A clonal expansion of myeloid blasts in the bone marrow, blood or other tissues. The classification of acute myeloid leukemias (AMLs) encompasses four major categories: 1) AML with recurrent genetic abnormalities; 2) AML with multilineage dysplasia; 3) Therapy-related AML; 4) AML not otherwise specified. The required bone marrow or peripheral blood blast percentage for the diagnosis of AML is 20% (WHO classification).

raw_context: Breast neoplasm; benign or malignant not stated.
rationale_ko: 유방의 양성 또는 악성 신생물을 포괄합니다. breast cancer보다 넓으며 악성·침윤성 또는 특정 조직형을 임의로 추가하지 않습니다.

definitions.text: A benign or malignant neoplasm of the breast parenchyma. It can originate from the ducts, lobules or the breast adipose tissue. Breast neoplasms are much more common in females than males.
A benign or malignant neoplasm of the breast parenchyma. It can originate from the ducts, lobules or the breast adipose tissue. Breast neoplasms are much more common in females than males.

raw_context: HER2-positive breast cancer confirmed by testing.
rationale_ko: 일반 HER2 양성 유방암을 보존합니다. MONDO와 NCIt 후보 정의는 ER 음성까지 요구하지만 NCI의 바이오마커 설명은 HER2 양성과 호르몬 수용체 상태를 구별하므로 해당 후보보다 넓은 로컬 범위를 선택합니다.

definitions.text: A biologic subset of breast carcinoma defined by high expression of HER2, GRB7, and TRAP100, and by lack of expression of estrogen receptor (ER).
A biologic subset of breast carcinoma defined by high expression of HER2, GRB7, and TRAP100, and by lack of expression of estrogen receptor (ER).

raw_context: HER2-negative breast cancer confirmed by testing.
rationale_ko: HER2 음성 유방암 표현을 공식 활성 MONDO의 Her2-receptor negative breast cancer 명칭과 NCI 바이오마커 구별로 대조합니다. HER2 양성이나 triple-negative로 바꾸지 않습니다.

raw_context: Patients with reduced renal function; duration not stated.
rationale_ko: NCIt은 renal impairment를 감소된 신기능으로 정의합니다. 원문과 범위가 맞으며 질환 외 Finding으로 분류한다는 정보도 보존합니다. 신부전의 정도나 CKD의 기간을 추가하지 않습니다.

definitions.text: An acute or chronic condition that is characterized by the inability of the kidneys to adequately filter the blood.
An acute or chronic condition where the kidneys are not functioning normally.
Diminished kidney function.
Diminished kidney function.

raw_context: Chronic kidney disease persisting for more than 3 months.
rationale_ko: 원문에 CKD 긴 이름과 3개월 초과 기간이 명시됩니다. 만성 신장질환에 연결하되 renal impairment 일반과 구분합니다.

definitions.text: Impairment of the renal function secondary to chronic kidney damage persisting for three or more months.
A disorder characterized by gradual and usually permanent loss of kidney function resulting in renal failure.
Impairment of the renal function secondary to chronic kidney damage persisting for three or more months.
Impairment of the renal function secondary to chronic kidney damage persisting for three or more months.

raw_context: Patients with MDS or AML; either diagnosis is eligible.
standard_name: Myelodysplastic syndrome OR acute myeloid leukemia
rationale_ko: 이 레코드의 실제 문맥은 MDS 또는 AML 중 하나가 적격한 OR 식입니다. NCIt의 MDS/AML라는 결합 질환명 후보가 있어도 원문의 논리식을 우선하여 동의어 병합하지 않습니다.

definitions.text: A clonal hematopoietic disorder characterized by dysplasia and ineffective hematopoiesis in one or more of the hematopoietic cell lines. The dysplasia may be accompanied by an increase in myeloblasts, but the number is less than 20%, which, according to the WHO guidelines, is the requisite threshold for the diagnosis of acute myeloid leukemia. It may occur de novo or as a result of exposure to alkylating agents and/or radiotherapy. (WHO, 2001)

Acute myeloid leukemia (AML) is a group of neoplasms arising from precursor cells committed to the myeloid cell-line differentiation. All of them are characterized by clonal expansion of myeloid blasts. AML manifests by fever, pallor, anemia, hemorrhages and recurrent infections.
A myelodysplastic syndrome characterized by the presence of dysplasia in one or more hematopoietic cell lineages and 10-19% blasts in bone marrow or peripheral blood.

raw_context: Healthy participants during normal pregnancy.
rationale_ko: NCIt의 정상 임신 개념은 산모와 태아가 정상인 임신을 뜻해 원문과 맞습니다. 외부 코드가 있어도 질환으로 바꾸지 않고 생리 상태로 구분합니다.

definitions.text: A pregnancy that is normal for both the mother and the fetus.

raw_context: Management of symptoms during menopause.
rationale_ko: NCIt·MeSH에서 폐경 자체의 개념을 확인했습니다. 원문은 폐경 중 증상 관리이므로 생애 단계와 미지정 증상을 구별하며 CTCAE 출처의 disorder 표현을 그대로 개체 유형에 복사하지 않습니다.

definitions.text: A disorder characterized by the permanent cessation of menses, usually defined by 12 consecutive months of amenorrhea in a woman over 45 years of age.
The permanent cessation of menses, usually defined by 6 to 12 months of amenorrhea in a woman over 45 years of age.

The time of life when a woman's ovaries stop producing hormones and menstrual periods stop. Natural menopause usually occurs around age 50. A woman is said to be in menopause when she hasn't had a period for 12 months in a row. Symptoms of menopause include hot flashes, mood swings, night sweats, vaginal dryness, trouble concentrating, and infertility.

The last menstrual period. Permanent cessation of menses (MENSTRUATION) is usually defined after 6 to 12 months of AMENORRHEA in a woman over 45 years of age. In the United States, menopause generally occurs in women between 48 and 55 years of age.

raw_context: Persistent thirst; underlying disease not established.
rationale_ko: MeSH의 Thirst 개념에 연결하되 원인 질환을 추론하지 않습니다. HPO 검색 첫 결과 Polydipsia는 과다 섭취까지 정의하므로 지속적 갈증만 적힌 원문에 그대로 적용하지 않습니다.

definitions.text: A drive stemming from a physiological need for WATER.
Excessive thirst manifested by excessive fluid intake.

raw_context: Prevention of skeletal-related events in bone metastases.
rationale_ko: 원문은 골전이에서 SRE의 예방입니다. 골전이는 배경 질환이고 SRE는 사건의 묶음입니다. 정확 검색에서 외부 후보를 확보하지 못했으므로 사건 개념을 보존하며 골전이의 동의어로 만들지 않습니다.

raw_context: Seasonal symptoms triggered by ragweed pollen exposure.
rationale_ko: ACAAI의 임상적 돼지풀 꽃가루 알레르기 설명과 원문 유발 요인을 대조했습니다. 기존 MONDO 후보는 유전 감수성 범위이므로 Exact로 대체하지 않습니다. 현재 검색으로 적합한 외부 코드를 확보하지 못했어도 임상 개념은 유지합니다.

raw_context: 원문: Adults with plaque psoriasis. 정규화 결과: eczema.
rationale_ko: 키워드 eczema와 문맥 plaque psoriasis가 충돌합니다. 어느 입력 필드가 잘못됐는지 알 수 없어 외부 검색으로 한쪽을 정답 처리하지 않습니다.

raw_context: Study eligibility mentions Atopic dermatitis. No further subtype or diagnostic details are provided.
rationale_ko: 아토피 피부염의 만성 염증성 습진 유형입니다. 일반 eczema와 상하위 범위를 구별하고 atopic eczema 명칭은 같은 임상 개념으로 인정합니다.

definitions.text: A common chronic pruritic inflammatory skin disease with a strong genetic component. Onset typically occurs during the first 2 years of life.

A common form of eczema that is characterized by chronic skin inflammation, dryness, pruritus, and irritation. It often presents in patients with allergies and may more commonly be noted on the folds of the skin or the scalp.

raw_context: Study eligibility mentions Contact dermatitis. No further subtype or diagnostic details are provided.
rationale_ko: 접촉 물질에 의한 피부염 일반으로 자극성·알레르기성 기전을 포함합니다. K027/K028 중 어느 아형인지 추론하지 않습니다.

definitions.text: An inflammatory skin condition caused by direct contact between the skin and either an irritating substance or an allergen.
An inflammatory skin condition caused by direct contact between the skin and either an irritating substance or an allergen.
